the Kdp system is not a K+‐sensing system but a phosphate‐sensing system.
the KdpD/KpdE system is a sensor for the availability of K+, whereas PhoR/PhoB is the sensor of phosphate limitation and the KdpFABC and PstSCAB systems are both K+ and phosphate transporters.
